note: Illustrative logistic-regression coefficients for case-outcome prediction (chargesheet A vs C), hand-set — NOT the output of a training run. The integration step in pipeline/analytics.py was intended to overwrite this file and never did: it trains snake_case features (gravity_heinous, victim_count, ...) while the ones below are camelCase/one-hot, which is how you can tell no run produced them. `auc` is therefore a placeholder constant, not a measured ROC-AUC, and aucMeasured says so to every consumer. Caste/religion are NEVER features.
